description: What tools/quality/portal2_material_shots.py checks on each shot of portal2-water-v1 against the retail reference (reference.json, numbers only). Tiles: a 16x12 grid of mean colours; a tile matches when every channel is within the tolerance (8-bit sRGB) of retail's. The goo animates (its flow and sludge), so regions judge its mean colour and contrast over a patch, as portal2-materials-v1 does for animated goo. Every region names the defect it pins.
